N001.summary: Early game with moderate production and heavy tech investment, economy heavy, expansion light. Maintain current economy and technology development, keep production steady, and avoid overcommitting to army composition.
N001.title: Early Economy and Tech Focus
N001.trigger_summary: Early game with moderate production and heavy tech investment, economy heavy, expansion light.

N002.summary: Early-midgame with heavy production, heavy economy, and heavy expansion, still heavy tech. Continue scaling production and expansion while maintaining tech development. Keep army composition flexible.
N002.title: Scaling Production and Expansion
N002.trigger_summary: Early-midgame with heavy production, heavy economy, and heavy expansion, still heavy tech.

N003.summary: Midgame with a ground-based army, heavy production, heavy economy, heavy expansion, and heavy defense. Maintain your ground army and continue to develop economy and tech. Be ready to defend against possible pressure.
N003.title: Ground Army Consolidation
N003.trigger_summary: Midgame with a ground-based army, heavy production, heavy economy, heavy expansion, and heavy defense.

N004.summary: Late-midgame with a ground army including Immortals, heavy production, economy, expansion, and defense. Continue to develop your ground army and tech. Consider adding Dark Templar for harassment or to counter specific compositions.
N004.title: Advanced Ground Tech
N004.trigger_summary: Late-midgame with a ground army including Immortals, heavy production, economy, expansion, and defense.
